title: Optimal Transport Meets t-SNE: Integrated Visualization without Batch Effects in OT-tSNE
abstract: arXiv:2611.32402v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Visual exploration is an integral step in understanding the structure of datasets. However, systematic variation between datasets collected under different conditions, known as batch effects, can obscure shared structure and complicate their joint visualization. Existing methods often rely on cross-batch nearest-neighbor relations to integrate the batches. Yet, these local correspondences can be unreliable for challenging cross-batch geometries. We propose optimal-transport t-SNE (OT-tSNE), which replaces nearest-neighbor-based matching with globally coupled affinities derived from entropic optimal transport. Controlled synthetic experiments demonstrated that nearest-neighbor-based methods can deteriorate, while optimal-transport affinities and OT-tSNE embeddings remain robust. translated_title: 最优传输遇见 t-SNE：OT-tSNE 实现无批次效应的整合可视化
translated_abstract: 可视化探索是理解数据集结构不可或缺的步骤。然而，在不同条件下收集的数据集之间存在的系统性差异（即批次效应）会掩盖数据的共同结构，并使其联合可视化变得复杂。现有方法通常依赖跨批次的最近邻关系来整合批次，但对于具有挑战性的跨批次几何结构，这些局部对应关系可能并不可靠。我们提出了最优传输 t-SNE（OT-tSNE），用基于熵正则化最优传输推导的全局耦合亲和度取代基于最近邻的匹配。受控合成实验表明，基于最近邻的方法可能出现退化，而最优传输亲和度和 OT-tSNE 嵌入则保持稳健。在七个真实的单细胞数据集上，我们将 OT-tSNE 与广泛的整合和可视化方法进行了基准比较，发现它实现了帕累托最优的（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: OT-tSNE 用熵正则化最优传输的全局耦合亲和度取代跨批次最近邻匹配，在单细胞数据整合可视化中有效消除批次效应并保持稳健性。
en_tdlr: OT-tSNE replaces nearest-neighbor cross-batch matching with globally coupled affinities derived from entropic optimal transport, achieving robust, batch-effect-free integrated visualization across single-cell datasets.
